en: "Oh, long time no see! It's me! It's {bb}Hikoboshi{ww}!"{KP}"Momotaro-san! Please, lend me your strength!"{KP}"Two dark clouds have settled over the bridge that crosses to Orihime Village,"{KP}"so the wind and rain won't stop, and we can't get to Orihime Village!"{KP}"It's Tanabata, and yet I can't even see {bb}Orihime-san{ww}!"{KP}"All of us villagers have tried everything, but it only gets worse..."{KP}"If only we had the {bb}Giant Fan{ww} that {bb}Daruma Tengu{ww} is said to have..."{KP}"Momotaro-san, please use your strength to drive away those dark clouds!"{KP}"I'm begging you!"

jp:
「どうか　桃太郎さんの
　おちからで　あの　暗雲を
　追いはらって　ください！」{KP}
　
「お願いします！」
en: "Momotaro-san, please use your strength to drive away those dark clouds!"{KP}"I'm begging you!"

jp:
「ありがとうございました
　桃太郎さん！」
　{KP}
「あと　橋さえ　直れば
　{bb}おりひめさん{ww}に
　会えるのですが…」
en: "Thank you so much, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"If only the bridge were fixed, I could see {bb}Orihime-san{ww}..."
